name: hEVO
description: A haplotype-based DNA foundation model that learns DNA representations from population-scale haplotype sequence variation and produces REF/ALT likelihood scores.

attributes.access: Checkpoints and benchmark data are on Hugging Face and are gated for peer review with manual approval by MulinLab; the benchmark evaluators, source tables and figure renderers are in the public GitHub repository; pretraining and preprocessing code is in a separate manually gated HF repository.
attributes.training_data: Stage I: deduplicated haplotype windows with span-masked representation learning. Stage II: variant-centred contexts with nucleotide prediction-head calibration.
attributes.provenance_note: Requested in rewire-benchmark-data issue #250. Added by the intake agent on 2026-11-19 as metadata only; no evaluation or result was extracted.
